name: AKER FERN
source:
A comedy in a school setting. What makes the main character different is the fact that he can perfectly remember who he was in his previous life. The mystery of him, as well as the ones regarding characters he encounters will become key elements of the game's story.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344840]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部以学校为背景的喜剧。主角的不同之处在于，他可以清楚地记得自己前世是谁。他的谜团以及他遇到的角色的谜团将成为游戏故事的关键元素。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344840]Steam[/url]]
